## Page 4

Q3 2025 Financial Highlight
❑Sales Revenue: decrease 11.8% YoY to 1,651 million Baht which decline in both the pet food and the human shelf -stable 
food, which was primarily the result of the depreciation of the US dollar against the Thai Baht. The total revenue 
decreased by 3.2% QoQ, mainly due to a decline in sales of the pet food, which was partly offset by increase in the 
human shelf -stable food.
❑Gross Profit:  recorded 229 million Baht, a decrease of 35.9% YoY and 15.0% QoQ. The gross profit margin for the quarter 
was 13.9%, declined compared to 19.1% in Q3 Y2024 and 15.8% in previous quarter, mainly due to the impact of the 
depreciation of the US dollar against the Thai Baht.
❑Net Profit: decreased 38.6% YoY and 8.7% QoQ mostly pressured by low GPM.
❑Earnings per share: were 0.08 Baht/share (Q2 2024: 0.14 Baht/share, Q1 2025: 0.12 Baht/share).4

Q3 2025 Pet Food Development
❑In Q3 2025, AAI developed and launched a total of 106 new pet food for customers, comprising 96 cat food 
and 10 dog food, which include complete and complementary. The launch of new products was robust as 
these are part of plan to cope with reciprocal tariff which had been finalized during the quarter.
❑Key markets are USA and Europe still. The decline in revenue was primarily due to the impact of exchange 
rates, as the company was unable to adjust prices to compensate for US dollar depreciation because of 
pressure from reciprocal tariff measures.
❑Sales are expected to recover in Q4 2025.Remark: Revenues is ex cluded intercompany sales.
